description: This file contains driver implementations for MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) operations specific to the Ralink MT7620 switch and integrated PHYs. It includes functions for reading and writing MDIO registers, managing link state, and handling carrier status in a network driver context.

methods.name: int mt7620_mii_busy_wait(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw)
methods.description: Waits until the MDIO interface is free or times out.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_write(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 phy_addr,u32 phy_register,u32 write_data)
methods.description: Performs a low-level MDIO write operation to a PHY register.

methods.name: u32 _mt7620_mii_read(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Performs a low-level MDIO read operation from a PHY register.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_write(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg,u16 val)
methods.description: Public wrapper to write data to a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: int mt7620_mdio_read(struct mii_bus * bus,int phy_addr,int phy_reg)
methods.description: Public wrapper to read data from a PHY register via MDIO.

methods.name: void mt7530_mdio_w32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a specific MDIO register on the MT7620 switch.

methods.name: u32 mt7530_mdio_r32(struct mt7620_gsw * gsw,u32 reg)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a specific MDIO register on the MT7620 switch.

methods.name: unsigned char * fe_speed_str(int speed)
methods.description: Converts a speed code into a human-readable string.

methods.name: int mt7620_has_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Checks if any port on the switch currently has carrier detected.

methods.name: void mt7620_handle_carrier(struct fe_priv * priv)
methods.description: Updates the network carrier status based on the current link status.

methods.name: void mt7620_print_link_state(struct fe_priv * priv,int port,int link,int speed,int duplex)
methods.description: Logs the link state and speed/duplex info for a port.

methods.name: void mt7620_mdio_link_adjust(struct fe_priv * priv,int port)
methods.description: Adjusts link and carrier status based on current PHY/link information.
